ca-sb1.bill: Road Repair and Accountability Act of 2017
ca-sb1.leverage_point: Residents can advocate for local project prioritization using SB 1 funds.
ca-sb1.summary: Invests $54 billion over 10 years for road maintenance, public transit, and pedestrian/bicycle infrastructure improvements.

ca-sb71.bill: California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Exemptions for Transportation Projects
ca-sb71.leverage_point: Residents can support projects benefiting from CEQA exemptions at local planning meetings.
ca-sb71.summary: Makes CEQA exemptions for transportation projects permanent, enhancing public transportation and safety.

ca-sb237.leverage_point: Residents can discuss the impact of gasoline supply strategies at local energy meetings.
ca-sb237.summary: Aims to stabilize gasoline prices and supply by adjusting CEQA requirements and gasoline specifications.

ca-ab1147.leverage_point: Residents can advocate for transit-oriented development projects in their communities.
ca-ab1147.summary: Encourages transit-oriented development by streamlining local processes.

ca-ab2097.leverage_point: Residents can support local projects that reduce parking requirements and enhance active transportation options.
ca-ab2097.summary: Prohibits local governments from imposing minimum parking requirements near transit stations, promoting more pedestrian and bicycle-friendly infrastructure.
